headline: American Electric Power Co Inc's Dividend Analysis
summary: American Electric Power Co Inc (NASDAQ:AEP) recently announced a total dividend of $0.95 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-10.  This upcoming payment includes a $0.95 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-10.  As investors look forward to this payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
